{{Quote|Now that those muggers have been dealt with, we need to go after their leader, Vaigon Shinn. Go to his hideout, fight your way through his guards, and take him down.|[[Peawp R'dawc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM" />}}
'''Vaigon Shinn's Hideout''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forward base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="UiME" /> The bunker was used as a hideout by a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] mugger named [[Vaigon Shinn]], and his [[Shinn muggers|band]] of cronies. It was located on the southwestern outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]]'s combat expert [[Peawp R'dawc]] tasked a spacer to eliminate Vaigon Shinn in his hideout.<ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM" /> A short time later, the thug [[Sleash]] went into hiding in Vaigon Shinn's Hideout after the crime boss [[Faeto]] placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on his partner [[Untas]].<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Faeto's Job|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vaigon Shinn's Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:TaTaHOM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vaigon Shinn's Hideout was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
